title: Segments count every member: the member_traits read pages past the 1,000-row cap and a failed read stops instead of matching nobody
detail: loadMemberSnapshots read member_traits, member_tags and the real-member profile ids in one unranged select each. PostgREST caps an unranged select at max_rows (1000) and production holds about 1,718 member_traits rows, so segment counts on /admin/segments, the live preview and every campaign audience resolved from a trait segment silently dropped the members past the first page. Each read also ended in `data ?? []`, so a failed read looked like a segment nobody matches. Fix: all three reads go through readAllSnapshotRows, which orders by a unique key (member_traits by its primary key profile_id, trait_key) and pages with .range() until a short page. A read error is logged as segments.snapshot_read_failed and thrown, so a campaign send stops rather than shrinking its audience (the same rule lib/studio/campaigns.ts readAllPages follows). lib/traits/segments-snapshots.test.ts now mocks the 1,000-row cap and pins a 1,718-row read and the throw.

verify.note: Fails on main: member_traits is read unpaged and a read error becomes an empty list. Passes when the read pages and an error throws.
